messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Renewal accepted by Altus Labs but procurement is insisting the invoice come from their reseller (CloudChannel Partners). They want a reseller PO and a reseller-signed SOW before execution. cc @dan_ae

dan_ae: Ok thanks. I thought this was direct. Do we have an existing reseller billing flow for this account?

sarah_legal: We can do partner-billed deals but need partner addendum + reseller EIN + signature. Also need to confirm DPA scope if data handling changes.

raj_finance: Important: confirm currency + tax treatment. Also they requested Net45 — we typically do Net30 unless credit check passes. For partner invoices we need partner W-9/EIN and banking details up front.

zach_se: Note: Altus requested Dedicated GPU add-on and EU key residency for logs. If they require EU hosting or KMS in EU that affects pricing and requires a different SOW line item.

clara_onboard: Provisioning note: we can only schedule Dedicated capacity AFTER SOW signed and KMS info is supplied. Lead time ~10 business days for EU region ops prep.

maria_cs: Action items I think: (1) legal to prepare reseller addendum + region clause, (2) finance to confirm Net45 subject to credit, (3) sales to loop partner and gather partner EIN/banking, (4) onboarding to hold provisioning slot. Agree?

sarah_legal: Yes. I'll draft partner addendum + a short EU hosting rider. Need partner legal contact + reseller full legal name. I'm away from 3/28-3/30 but can do initial draft today.

raj_finance: I can run a credit check today. If credit passes we can approve Net45 for this partner-backed deal. Otherwise Net30. Also confirm invoicing recipient (partner only or partner + copy to customer).

zach_se: If we add EU KMS, we should include a separate line item for KMS onboarding and per-region rate. I'll prepare a pricing snippet to include in the SOW.

dan_ae: I'll loop CloudChannel and ask for EIN + billing contact. I'll also ask procurement whether they need dual invoices (one to reseller, one to end-customer) or just partner routing. Scheduling: I set a 15-min call with partner + our team tomorrow 10am PT.

maria_cs: Draft email to partner/procurement (posting here for review):
```
Hi team — thanks for confirming renewal. To move forward we need: 1) Partner invoice details (legal name, EIN, address, billing contact), 2) Signed reseller addendum + SOW (we will share draft), 3) Confirmation on Net terms (requested Net45), and 4) If EU hosting/KMS required, confirm region and key management point of contact.

Please confirm availability for a short sync tomorrow 10am PT.
Best, Maria (CS)
```

sarah_legal: LGTM — I'll attach the partner addendum and EU rider to that email. Please include partner contact emails when you send.

raj_finance: After partner details come in I'll kick off the credit check and flag whether Net45 approved. If we need Net30 we'll surface that before SOW finalization.

clara_onboard: Once SOW with region + KMS is signed and partner billing confirmed, I'll book provisioning. Blocked until signed SOW + KMS certs.

maria_cs: Great. I'll send draft to Dan, copy legal & finance, then loop partner. Will update thread after the call. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: (post-call follow-up TBD)
